html:
SMTO-MEM-0028 — This collection name can't be used

GUID: 8749f9e7-8009-5d19-9274-de8266de185e
Slug: knowledge-invalid-name
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • A Knowledge collection needs a name between 1 and 240 characters. The name you entered was blank, only spaces, or too long, so no collection was created.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Knowledge, open New collection under Private collections and type a short name such as “Support handbook”. Don't use a name made only of spaces. Spaces at the start and end are removed, so a name of only spaces counts as blank.
  2. If you pasted a long title, shorten it to 240 characters or fewer. SMTO only accepts collection names up to 240 characters.
  3. Select Create collection. The collection is created only once the name passes these checks.

What success looks like

  • The new collection appears under Private collections with the name you typed.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name you tried, to the person who manages SMTO. You don't need to delete any existing collection to fix this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagStore.collection rejected the collection name because it was not a string or, after trimming surrounding whitespace, was empty or longer than 240 characters.

What this means

  • The source needs a usable display name before it can be saved. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported invalid_name. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The source saves under the chosen name.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Send POST /api/agent/rag/collections with a name string whose trimmed length is 1 to 240 characters. Nothing was stored for the rejected request, so creating the collection again with a valid name is safe.
  • Enter a nonempty source name within the form’s length limit and save again.

Retry and execution caution

  • The source saves under the chosen name.

How to verify the fix

  • The source saves under the chosen name.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
